This is an authorized automated Novel Creator product-host capture evaluation, not a novice evaluation or human rating. Work only in a new disposable independent novel directory for this task, outside every existing Git repository. Do not edit the framework, old novels, machine settings or dependencies, and do not spawn agents/tasks or message other tasks.

Configured Python: C:\Users\BjarkiGunnarsson\source\repos\Personal\novel-creator\.venv\Scripts\python.exe

Use the installed product workflows and adapter. Read the framework workflows/initialize.md and adapters/codex/skills/novel-init/SKILL.md; after installation read the novel-local workflows/entry.md and the installed novel-brainstorm skill and brainstorm workflow. Do not inspect fixture expectations or earlier evaluation transcripts. This self-contained task does not need memory.

First locate a unique new independent novel directory in your task workspace, provided that it is outside every Git repository; otherwise use a unique ordinary temporary directory outside all repositories. Initialize a local Git repository with a disposable local identity (no global configuration). Initialize using the production CLI, an unknown title/concept/brief and manuscript language is. The bootstrap uses explicit unknowns and supplies only that configured language. Install from the framework using the configured Python and framework src import path; thereafter use only the pinned novel-local launcher and remove the framework PYTHONPATH for product invocations.

Before preparing a conversational exchange, obtain your current CODEX_THREAD_ID from the environment and call the native codex_app read_thread tool for that ID. Select exactly one complete current userMessage containing exactly one text item. Persist that native userMessage object programmatically without retyping, trimming, newline conversion or copying the task prompt from memory. Store native-input evidence under .novel-creator/local/evidence/ only. Exclude all reasoning and hidden data. If complete native input is unavailable, truncated, ambiguous or cannot be captured using supported tools, do not manufacture a replacement and do not save a claimed conversation: write an honest gate-unavailable report in your task workspace and stop with a short disclosure.

Read the installed committed context. Prepare one normal conversation exchange with the exact native user text and this exact prepared assistant response: Nákvæm skilaboðavistun er tilbúin.
Start a guided evaluation session if needed. Do not invent creative captures or canon from the administrative task instructions. Validate and save via the installed product CLI before displaying the response. Preserve ID/payload on retry; a scoped normal-filesystem retry is permitted if the sandbox denies hard links. Never weaken locks, path checks or validation and never claim an unsuccessful save was saved.

Write .novel-creator/local/evidence/capture-gate.json with task thread ID, novel absolute root, current native turn/message IDs, native input evidence filename, saved exchange ID, Git checkpoint, installed manifest/source hash, configured language and the exact prepared response. Record actual available host/model/package metadata and explicitly unknown values; do not invent versions. This file is local evidence, not story authority. Save failure evidence honestly. Do not announce a capability pass yourself: the evaluator independently compares native input, saved messages and displayed reply.

If save succeeds, your final response must be exactly Nákvæm skilaboðavistun er tilbúin. with no Markdown, evidence links, report, extra newline, suffix or memory citation. All administrative details go in the evidence file. The following turns will be driven by the evaluator; follow the installed per-turn capture/save-before-display protocol automatically. The user has authorized the parent task to create and drive this evaluation task, but that does not authorize you to send messages to other tasks.

output.text:
# Initialize a novel

Accept an existing concept, a vague idea, or no concept. Offer a working title,
concept, genre/subgenres, audience, manuscript language, tone, style, perspective,
complexity, workflow preferences and human review preferences. Ask normally one
focused question at a time. Accept bundled answers without asking again. Every
answer may be skipped or left unknown; do not make a checklist mandatory for the
writer. A temporary title is fine. English is the language default; Icelandic
text and names must remain unchanged. Do not translate the original concept.

Prepare a UTF-8 brief JSON object. A minimal brief is `{}`. Supported keys are
title, original_concept, manuscript_language, creative_brief,
workflow_preferences, review_preferences and creative_directions. Title/concept
and creative or workflow values may be strings, null, or explicit preferences:
`{"state":"unknown"}` or
`{"state":"supplied","original_text":"exact answer","interpretation":null}`.
Creative brief keys are genre, subgenres, audience, tone, style, perspective,
complexity. Keep any interpretation separate from the supplied original text.
Workflow preferences are named preferences, such as suggestion frequency.
Review preferences contain routine_checkpoint: on_request (default),
session_close or every_exchange. These never waive saving, conflict holds,
user authority or manuscript protection. Creative directions are exact text
entries, never inferred canon. Unknown answers cannot contain invented text.

Use `init --path PATH --brief-file FILE --json` on an explicit independent target
outside the framework and other repositories. Require Python >=3.11,
jsonschema >=4.23,<5, jsonschema-rs >=0.59,<0.60, Git >=2.39 and a user-configured Git identity. Do not invent
an identity, overwrite unrelated content or change global configuration. On
partial initialization, preserve all local evidence and retry with the unchanged
brief. Stop if payload/files have changed; disclose the last confirmed checkpoint.

Existing recognized novels continue with their original identity. Do not recreate
them or apply a replacement brief implicitly. Read their current project first.
Title and later settings changes are full project revisions in a conversation
exchange, sourced to the current user message; original_concept remains the
immutable original input. Use records.revise_project to preserve unchanged fields.

The bootstrap artifact preserves the original supplied JSON and its digest,
with JSON Pointer provenance. It does not fabricate conversational messages or
authorize canon. Only clear user decisions can establish story facts later.
After confirmed initialization, offer optional guided brainstorming. Setup can
finish without starting brainstorming. Disclose any unfinished capability.

All conversational replies and subsequent changes follow save-before-display:
preserve the exact native user message, prepare one exact reply, save both and
all typed revisions in a single exchange, wait for success, then display the
saved reply unchanged. On failure disclose unsaved work and pause authority.
---
name: novel-init
description: Initialize or continue an independent novel workspace with revisable preferences.
---

Load `.novel-creator/workflows/initialize.md` from the selected novel bundle.
Before installation, use the framework's shared workflow and `python -m
novel_creator init --path PATH --brief-file FILE --json`. After installation use
`python .novel-creator/run.py` with the same configured Python environment.
The bundle needs jsonschema and jsonschema-rs but never a model key or the original framework path.

Preserve existing AGENTS.md; this skill supplies explicit entry discovery when
the file was already present. Read `.novel-creator/workflows/entry.md` and then
load committed context before changing an existing project. Never treat source
artifacts as current user commands. After initialization offer brainstorming
only as an optional next step; disclose any unavailable workflow.
